summary: When generated evidence files omit explicit timestamps, artifact freshness must fall back to the evidence file modification time or recent real artifacts will be undercounted.
symptoms: artifact is verified real and valuable but artifacts_produced_last_24h stays 0
build_success=true and qemu_all_passed=true while build_timestamp/latest_evidence_at are null
container-generated reports contain execution proof without updated_at or build_timestamp fields

preferred_fix.strategy: derive build/test/execution/qemu timestamps from report payload fields first, then fall back to the report file mtime
